lens: Geometry and proportion first, then colour. Candidate renders are S/r48 (q15-q17) and S/s48 (studio); w47 (b65def4) renders S/r47 and S/s47 are the before. I read the 28cdd3c diff of 09a_econ.js. My w47 scripts were copied to /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/2fb1f2ef-fbd7-5fb9-b7d2-14a3db7265c8/scratchpad/raterB48/ with the same boxes (b.py, m.py, p.py, c2.py, t.py), retargeted r47->r48 with r47 as the 'before'. New scripts: t2.py measures the near-right teal with the row-ahead strap excluded; cov.py measures the near headrest cover blob; arm.py measures the white runs under the aisle arm; top.py profiles the back tops. Crops: q17_blend.png, upper.png, coverpair.png, nearR.png, arm2.png, left.png, pocket.png, q15c.png, studio.png.
calibrationNote: Camera: the 50 % blend of r48 q17 with y_47303 still lines up the aisle arm noses (top white run starts at y 415-419 vs 419-421 at x 540-620) and the window tops. The windows are still out of phase horizontally, which is the known layout residual. The w47b-3 back-height offset is mostly gone: the near back top is ~14 px above the photo (w47: ~30), the right-block and second-row tops are ~20 px above (w47: 30-48), and q15 head-on back top-to-pillow-foot / width is within ~2 % of y_47300 (w47: +4 %). That pass is a visual crop estimate (q15c.png); a numeric screen-blob fit was too noisy to use. Prior medium issues: w47b-3 mostly fixed; w47b-2 partly fixed (the teal now has the right shape, axis and size, but sits ~40-50 px off, at the arm front); w47b-1 not fixed (the cover is slightly darker than in w47). Prior lows: w47b-4 partly fixed (navy fixed, teal unchanged); w47b-5 partly fixed (the pocket geometry is taller, but it still reads dark). With the back shorter, one more geometry mismatch shows: the aisle-end lower bracket. A gap now opens under the arm (11-13 px, w47 0-5), but the bracket's front bar is still ~23 px above the photo's (w48b-2). Detail mean 8.50 (w47 8.47). Overall 8.6: up 0.05 for the back proportion, pocket and navy fixes, held by the cover colour and placement, the right-seat strap placement and the end bracket.

priorIssues.note: Not changed in 28cdd3c. Same boxes (c2.py): near cover (126,133,171) L*56 vs photo (143,162,201) L*66; right-block (106,119,181) L*51 vs (157,178,217) L*72. cov.py near-cover blob median (117,124,164), w47 (123,130,168): slightly darker. Check (L* 62-70, G/R >= 1.10) not met: G/R 1.06.

t2.py, near-right teal with the row-ahead strap excluded: bbox 842-867 x 395-428 (26 x 34 px, axis 64 deg); w47 818-868 x 369-427 (51 x 59, 53 deg); photo 774-813 x 348-393 (40 x 46, 59 deg). The size and axis checks are met. But the centroid is (855,411) vs the photo's (802,372): 53 px toward the aisle and 39 px forward. It sits at the arm front instead of hanging from the back crease to mid-pan, where the photo's tongue meets the buckle on the navy. The navy now starts under the arm front (good); its smooth-pixel luma is 55-56 vs photo 52-53.

Back 4.5 % shorter. q17 (upper.png): near back top ~138 vs photo ~152 (w47 ~122), so 14 px, inside the 15 px check. Right-block and second-row tops are ~20 px high (w47 30-48). q15: back h/w is about equal to y_47300 (crop estimate 205/108 vs 208/110; w47 +4 %). The near headrest cover blob is still 30-42 px above the photo's (159-240 vs 189-282), more than the back top. See w48b-1.
Navy #353b4e: smooth luma 55 (nearL) / 56 (nearR) vs photo 52-53, inside the 52-62 check (fixed). Teal not changed: L*47-48 vs photo 51-54 (not fixed).

The pouches are now ~2x taller with a bulge (pocket.png, e6). y_47303 shows a light-grey fabric pouch with dark mesh panels at its sides. The render pouch is a dark net over a near-black backing: mean luma 63 in its zone vs 101 for the photo's (boxes differ, indicative), and darker than r47's 82. Geometry fixed, value not.
The non-drape strap branch is unchanged in 28cdd3c.
Pillow flat plaque, side-block pillows off (user question), centre stubs, fleck contrast, dark edge under the pan front: all unchanged (q15c.png, e11).

Held. The aisle-end gap now opens under the arm (11-13 px vs 0-5 in w47; photo 34-44), but the lower bracket's front bar is still 23 px above the photo's and runs parallel to the arm, where the photo's sweeps diagonally up to the arm's rear (w48b-2). Under-arm dark-grey px 538 (w47 533, photo 204).

Up 0.3. q15 h/w about equal to y_47300 (w47 +4 %); q17 near back top within 14 px.
Up 0.1: the shorter back brings the forward-row screens and hoods within ~15-20 px of the photo in q17.
Up 0.2: tall bulging pouches (e6, q17 left). They still read as a dark grille, not y_47303's light-grey pouch (w47b-5 carried).
